FC_CLAIM_NOT_READY: The creator fee claim is not ready, because the pool must hold the minimum real NEAR for 24 hours and the balance must be above zero.
FC_CREATOR_CAP: This would take the creator group above 4% of supply, so try a smaller amount.
FC_EARLY_WINDOW: Early supply cannot sell in the early blocks, and selling opens when the early window ends.
FC_LARGE_CANNOT_SEND: A large account cannot send tokens until its balance is zero.
FC_NOT_CREATOR: The creator account is the one that can claim the creator fees.
FC_ONE_YOCTO: Confirm this call in your wallet, because it needs exactly 1 yoctoNEAR attached.
FC_RECEIVER_WOULD_BE_LARGE: This send would make the receiver a large holder, so send a smaller amount.
FC_SEND_TO_COIN: Do not send tokens to the coin account, and use the sell button to sell.
FC_SLIPPAGE: The price moved below your minimum, so try again or lower your minimum.
FC_TRANSFER_CALL: This coin does not allow transfer and call, so use a plain send.
FC_UNREGISTER_WITH_BALANCE: This account holds tokens or has used allowance, so it cannot unregister now.
